CREATE TABLE posts
(
    Id                    INTEGER          not null UNIQUE
        primary key,
    PostTypeId            INTEGER          null,
    AcceptedAnswerId      INTEGER          null,
    CreaionDate           DATETIME     null,
    Score                 INTEGER          null,
    ViewCount             INTEGER          null,
    Body                  TEXT     null,
    OwnerUserId           INTEGER          null,
    LasActivityDate       DATETIME     null,
    Title                 TEXT null,
    Tags                  TEXT null,
    AnswerCount           INTEGER          null,
    CommentCount          INTEGER          null,
    FavoriteCount         INTEGER          null,
    LastEditorUserId      INTEGER          null,
    LastEditDate          DATETIME     null,
    CommunityOwnedDate    DATETIME    null,
    ParentId              INTEGER          null,
    ClosedDate            DATETIME     null,
    OwnerDisplayName      TEXT null,
    LastEditorDisplayName TEXT null,
        foreign key (LastEditorUserId) references users (Id)
            on update cascade on delete cascade,
        foreign key (OwnerUserId) references users (Id)
            on update cascade on delete cascade,
        foreign key (ParentId) references posts (Id)
            on update cascade on delete cascade
)

```json
{"thought":"I have the schema for both tables. Posts has ViewCount, comments.csv has PostId and Score. I need to find posts with views 100-150, then find the comment with highest score for those posts.","action":"execute_python","action_input":{"code":"import sqlite3
import csv

# Get post IDs with view count between 100 and 150
conn = sqlite3.connect('db/posts.db')
cursor = conn.cursor()
cursor.execute('SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount >= 100 AND ViewCount <= 150')
valid_post_ids = set(row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall())
conn.close()

print(f'Number of valid posts: {len(valid_post_ids)}')

# Read comments and find highest score among valid posts
max_score = -float('inf')
best_comment = None

with open('csv/comments.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        post_id = int(row['PostId'])
        if post_id in valid_post_ids:
            score = int(row['Score'])
            if score > max_score:
                max_score = score
                best_comment = {
                    'Id': row['Id'],
                    'PostId': row['PostId'],
                    'Score': score,
                    'Text': row['Text'][:100] + '...' if len(row['Text']) > 100 else row['Text']
                }

print(f'Highest score: {max_score}')
print(f'Comment ID: {best_comment["Id"]}')
print(f'Comment text preview: {best_comment["Text"]}')
"}}}
```
